{{DISPLAYTITLE:VDW_S6}}
{{TAGDEF|VDW_S6|[real]}}

Description: {{TAG|VDW_S6}} sets a parameter in the damping function of van der Waals methods.
----
{{TAG|VDW_S6}} allows to set the value of a parameter in the following methods: 
*Scaling <math>s_{6}</math> of the dipole-dipole dispersion of the [[DFT-D2]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=1), DFT-D3, [[DFT-D4]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=13), [[DFT-ulg]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=3), and Tkatchenko-Scheffler methods  ({{TAG|IVDW}}=2 and 21). {{TAG|VDW_S6}} can be used for both implementations of DFT-D3: [[DFT-D3]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=11 or 12) and [[simple-DFT-D3]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=15).
*Steepness factor <math>a_0</math> in [[DDsC_dispersion_correction|DDsC]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=4).
{{NB|mind|The setting of <math>s_{6}</math> with {{TAG|VDW_S6}} when {{TAG|IVDW}}{{=}}11 or 12 (VASP implementation of [[DFT-D3]]) is possible since VASP.6.6.0.}}
